platform.title: Platform verification
platform.description: Every account verifies the account holder first. Enterprise verification becomes available afterwards and upgrades the account only when approved.
platform.personalFirst: Complete identity verification before enterprise verification
platform.gateFailed: Identity status is temporarily unavailable. Enterprise verification remains safely locked; try again later.

lead: Identity verification is completed once. Returning here never means approval; the system rechecks the authoritative Aliyun result.
loadFailed: Identity verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
personalOnly: This entry is for individual customers. Enterprise customers use the enterprise verification flow.
returnChecking: You returned from the verification page. The system is rechecking the result with Aliyun…
returnPending: The authoritative check completed, but Aliyun has not confirmed approval. Check again later instead of starting another attempt.
title: Verify who you are before the first payment

status.hint: Status comes only from local evidence or an authoritative Aliyun query, never result parameters in the browser address.
status.title: Current verification status

verified.description: The first-payment identity gate was updated from a server-authoritative result.
verified.name: Name
verified.title: Identity verification passed

payment.failed: Identity passed, but automatic payment recovery is temporarily unavailable. Retry from the original order without creating another order.
payment.pending: Identity passed, but the original payment preparation still needs a server recheck. You can retry safely from the order.
payment.ready: The original payment preparation was revalidated and is ready to continue.

review.description: There is no force-approve action. The merchant works from masked case evidence; never send a full identity number in a ticket.
review.title: Contact the merchant for assistance

retry.description: A rejected or expired attempt can be submitted again. Document and age checks still run on the server.
retry.title: You can start a new verification

form.invalid: Enter your legal name and a valid 18-digit resident identity number, then grant separate consent.
form.lead: The first release supports mainland Chinese individual customers aged 14 or above with an 18-digit resident identity card.
form.name: Legal name
form.namePlaceholder: Name exactly as shown on the identity card
form.safety: The name and identity number are never written to browser storage or retained in ordinary case, audit, or task records.
form.title: Enter your own identity information

consent.accept: I have read and separately consent to the sensitive-personal-information processing above, and I confirm this is my own information.
consent.data: Your legal name, 18-digit resident identity card number, and face/liveness information collected directly on the Aliyun verification page.
consent.purpose: Used to satisfy the first-payment identity requirement, prevent impersonation, and create an auditable verification conclusion. Declining prevents the first payment.
consent.recipient: The IDC merchant operating this site uses its own Aliyun account for financial-grade real-person verification. End customers neither configure nor pay for that technical account.
consent.rights: Contact the merchant to access, correct, or lawfully delete information, or withdraw consent for later processing. Withdrawal does not affect prior lawful processing and may prevent the first payment.
consent.storage: The provider integration region is mainland China. This system does not store face images or liveness video; it retains masked results, necessary evidence, and a protected encrypted snapshot for the period required by applicable law and the merchant privacy policy.
consent.title: Separate consent for sensitive personal information
